gen-audiowide-gf-oxygen: Audiowide draws tile-like letters with wide gaps and no stroke shift at all. Oxygen sits beneath it as a plain sans, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so the display face feels sleek and the text feels approachable.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Dark, gnarly, a bit menacing. Noto Sans Nabataean takes over below with a plain sans build whose lowercase stands almost cap-tall, giving the jagged heading a steadier counterweight.
gen-almendra-display-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme has stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height, which keeps its rounded letters clear. Almendra Display adds an ornate, literary heading above, and the text below it should read smoothly and without fuss.
gen-audiowide-gf-preahvihear: Audiowide skims along at a single stroke weight, its tall lowercase set like tiles with generous gaps between them. Preahvihear follows with a sans body whose lofty x-height and open letter mouths feel modern and easy to enter.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: A slight pinch where Eater's curves meet its straight stems gives the heading a bitten, aggressive edge. Noto Sans Nag Mundari then offers a sans-serif body with lowercase that rivals its capitals, and a larger body size would suit it nicely.
gen-almendra-display-gf-prompt: Prompt has an oversized look to its small letters and open apertures that read easily. Prompt carries the text while Almendra Display adds its ornate, literary flavor up top, and the sans-serif body keeps the heading from feeling heavy.
gen-audiowide-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption is a big-bodied sans-serif whose bowls stay unclosed and inviting, with a professional, contemporary feel. Audiowide handles the futuristic flair; the body handles the reading.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Eater brings a dark, aggressive heading with thin strokes that still carry real weight. Noto Sans Nandinagari answers in a sans-serif body with generous openings and a big lowercase, so giving the heading a little more size seems wise.
gen-almendra-display-gf-questrial: Almendra Display wears an ornate, literary look, its letters never pinching shut. But Questrial, a sans with flat strokes of single weight, would lose its quiet tall band of letters if the heading were made small.
gen-audiowide-gf-puritan: Futuristic and tech-minded, Audiowide keeps its monoline stroke from stem to serif for a bold, sleek heading. Puritan brings rounded, open forms and oversized e and a counters, making it the friendlier voice for the text.
